scripts.dev: pnpm run gen && pnpm --parallel --filter @exam-prep/learner --filter @exam-prep/org --filter @exam-prep/admin --filter @exam-prep/api run dev
scripts.dev:real: pnpm run gen && VITE_REAL=${VITE_REAL-} pnpm --parallel --filter @exam-prep/learner --filter @exam-prep/org --filter @exam-prep/admin --filter @exam-prep/api --filter @exam-prep/worker run dev
scripts.lint: pnpm run gen && prettier --check . && eslint --max-warnings=0 . && pnpm run deps:graph && python3 scripts/engineering/check_style_literals.py && python3 scripts/engineering/check_dependencies.py && pnpm run lint:copy
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run gen && tsc -b && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.test: pnpm run gen && vitest run --project node --project browser && python3 scripts/engineering/test_results.py tooling
scripts.test:db: pnpm run gen && vitest run --project db
scripts.build: pnpm run gen && pnpm --filter @exam-prep/learner --filter @exam-prep/org --filter @exam-prep/admin run build
scripts.e2e:smoke: pnpm run gen && playwright test tests/e2e/smoke --output=.test-results/smoke-artifacts
scripts.gallery: pnpm run gen && playwright test tests/e2e/gallery.spec.ts --output=.test-results/gallery-artifacts
